story: The Scaly Breasted Cupwing (Pnoepyga albiventer) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Pnoepygidae family. It is most commonly observed in Subtropical moist montane forest; dark/damp areas near streams; ravines; and boulders, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Scaly Breasted Cupwing is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Scaly Breasted Cupwing into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
